snippet.title: GRAIN ROT | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A horror online co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and escape the corrupted, then drag the haul home to rebuild the Outpost.

Wishlist GRAIN ROT now on Steam: https://play.neem.com/grain_rot

Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/8cU8SE3Rw3
